headline: Arsenal favourites, but Saka and a short week complicate it
summary: Arsenal host Everton on Saturday afternoon after a short turnaround: they drew 2-2 at Bayern Munich on Wednesday, and Bukayo Saka came off after 10 minutes with a leg problem. Everton have had a full week, but they created only 0.43 expected goals in their 0-2 home defeat to Chelsea. Arsenal are 2nd on 18 points and won the last meeting 2-0 in March. The market makes Arsenal 68.3% favourites, and Everton get a head start of 1.25 goals, with the goal line at 2.75.
read: Arsenal are strong 68.3% favourites at the Emirates and rated about a goal and a quarter the better side, but they arrive three days after a 2-2 in Munich in which Bukayo Saka came off injured after ten minutes. Everton have had a full week, yet they created only 0.43 xG in losing at home to Chelsea and have not beaten Arsenal in their last five meetings.

facts.fact: Bukayo Saka was forced off in the 10th minute with an apparent left leg injury during Arsenal's 2-2 Champions League draw at Bayern Munich on Wednesday.
facts.meaning: Arsenal could be without their first-choice right-sided attacker when they host Everton on Saturday afternoon.

facts.fact: Arsenal are 68.3% favourites to win at the Emirates.
facts.meaning: The market sees a clearly one-sided home game: Arsenal are more likely than not by a wide margin, and a draw or Everton win is the outsider outcome.

facts.fact: The main handicap is Arsenal -1.25, with the fair line at -1.28.
facts.meaning: The market rates Arsenal roughly a goal and a quarter better than Everton — a two-goal Arsenal win is needed for the handicap to land in full.

facts.fact: Arsenal played at Bayern Munich on Wednesday, three days before this match.
facts.meaning: Arsenal have a short turnaround; Everton, by contrast, have had a full week to prepare.

facts.fact: Everton created just 0.43 xG in their 0-2 home defeat to Chelsea last Saturday.
facts.meaning: They arrive at the Emirates off a game in which they barely made a chance, against a defence that has conceded 1.14 xG per game.

facts.fact: The goal line is 2.75, with over priced at 47.4%.
facts.meaning: The market expects a game just under three goals — under is the slightly favoured side of the line.

facts.fact: Arsenal are second in the Premier League with 18 points from seven games, six wins and one defeat.
facts.meaning: They are eight points clear of Everton, who are eighth — the table gap matches the size of the market's favourite tag.

facts.fact: Arsenal won the last meeting 2-0 at the Emirates in March and are unbeaten in the last five against Everton.
facts.meaning: Everton have not beaten Arsenal in five attempts, although two of those meetings finished level.

sources.fact: Bukayo Saka was forced off in the 10th minute with an apparent left leg injury during Arsenal's Champions League draw at Bayern Munich.
Mikel Arteta said Piero Hincapie could be available to face Everton if he is able to train in the coming days.
Piero Hincapie trained individually the day before the Bayern match and was expected to miss that game but could return against Everton.
Arsenal drew 2-2 at Bayern Munich in the Champions League, with Declan Rice scoring late after Harry Kane's penalty.
Arsenal beat Nottingham Forest 1-0 away in the Premier League in their previous league match.
The Athletic's Briefing questioned why Arsenal don't look like champions despite Noni Madueke winning another game for them.
David Moyes was left incandescent after decisions he felt went against Everton in their match against Chelsea.
David Moyes could have a decision to make at right-back ahead of the trip to Arsenal.
